nodes.title: SG-6.4 · Wire Approve, Retry and Reject in AdminApp
nodes.body:
Context: ExecutionPanel already renders Approve and Retry buttons via onApprove/onRetry props, and client.ts already has approveExecution and retryExecution, but AdminApp passes no handlers and there is no reject call or Reject control. Desired behavior: each action calls the backend, reloads Round and execution data, shows failures, and a 401 returns to the token gate. Expected result: the admin can approve, retry or reject from the console. Why: supervised publishing requires the admin to act on executions.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Approve is clicked, then POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve is sent with the Bearer token and the data reloads
- Given a FAILED execution, when Retry is clicked, then POST .../retry is sent and the data reloads
- Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Reject is clicked, then POST .../reject is sent and the data reloads
- Given an action that responds 401, when it is clicked, then the token gate with 'Invalid token' is shown
- Given an action that responds 500, when it is clicked, then an alert with the error message is shown


## Scope
- In scope: rejectExecution client function
- In scope: Reject button in ExecutionPanel
- In scope: action handlers in AdminApp
- Out of scope: Backend reject endpoint
- Out of scope: new lifecycle stages
- Preserve: Existing approveExecution/retryExecution signatures
- Preserve: Existing AdminApp token gate, stepper and panel behavior


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript, Vitest with mocked fetch only
- Use adminRequest and ApiError from game/frontend/src/api/client.ts


## Definition of done
- All three requirements implemented and unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · AdminApp runs execution actions, reloads, shows errors and returns to the token gate on 401
nodes.body:
AdminApp calls approveExecution, retryExecution and rejectExecution with the token, increments reloads on success, shows failures through actionError and routes 401 to the token gate via handleError.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given each action succeeds, when clicked, then the matching endpoint is called and executions are fetched again
- Given a 401, when an action is clicked, then the token gate shows 'Invalid token'
- Given a non-401 failure, when an action is clicked, then an alert shows the error message


## Scope
- In scope: AdminApp handlers and actionError state
- Out of scope: Round open/close behavior
- Preserve: Existing round actions and loading effect


## Technical constraints
- Reuse handleError and the reloads counter in AdminApp.tsx


## Definition of done
- Handlers wired to ExecutionPanel


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Add approveExecution, retryExecution and rejectExecution to the import list from '../api/client'.
Add const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined); after the reloads state.

Add async function runExecutionAction(action: (token: string, id: string) => Promise<ExecutionInfo>, id: string): clear actionError, await action(token, id), then setReloads((n) => n + 1); in catch, if err is ApiError with status 401 call handleError(err), otherwise setActionError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Request failed').

Pass onApprove={(id) => runExecutionAction(approveExecution, id)}, onRetry={(id) => runExecutionAction(retryExecution, id)}, onReject={(id) => runExecutionAction(rejectExecution, id)} and actionError={actionError} to ExecutionPanel.
